recipes.title: Cinnamon Roll Cottage Cheese Pancakes (Swirl)
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, maple syrup and milk until smooth.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and soda, then gently mix in the wet mixture until just combined.
Mix the melted butter, brown sugar and cinnamon.
On a buttered skillet over medium heat, pour about ¼ cup batter per pancake and drizzle some cinnamon butter on top.
When bubbles form and the bottom is golden, flip and cook until done and the swirl caramelizes. Serve with maple syrup or berries.
recipes.notes: Ingredients, steps and calories are the creator's; she only lists calories, so protein, carbs and fat are my estimate. Thin the batter with a little more milk if it's too thick.
